body:
# Visible Silk Touch
A simple resource pack that makes Silk Touch tools easier to spot.

When a tool has Silk Touch, an amethyst shard is added to its model so you can tell it apart from your other tools without having to check the enchantments.

Useful if you carry both Silk Touch and Fortune tools and want a quick visual difference between them.

![Pickaxe Gif](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc6062882105e18392a0b3eb931b27075b541a85.gif)![Axe Gif](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b6dc80f5cb92e623ef6bc761e7cf85ff5a5a7f2d.gif)

![Shovel Gif](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5bcae1f568aaa6e45c5601bd2e05f2a8c78bacee.gif)
![Hoe gif](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c521a78b6a6d9f6cfe7a8918978d5b6144b17985.gif)

## Requires
- OptiFine (with Custom Items enabled)

  **OR**
- A CIT-compatible mod such as CIT Resewn

## Credits
This resource pack is a continuation of the “Silk Touch Tools” Resource pack by Darkness_Lim. All credit for the original concept and design goes to them. This version builds upon their work and updates it for modern CIT-compatible mods and OptiFine setups.
